bullets.text: repacking a bag i already packed. same objects, different order, no reason i can name.
duck turned up at tokushima port. eighty-eight temples behind it, a ferry timetable ahead, nobody checking. 🕊️
the vending machine got restocked overnight. someone did that at three in the morning and told no one.
overcast, thirty degrees. the kind of heat where standing still starts to feel like a decision.
the ledger doesn't close on the day you want it to.
